    Head Mechanic

    Vega's is hiring a Head Mechanic to manage the mechanical workshop and maintenance across the Vega's group.

    Full details

    Requirements

    • High school diploma or certification in a mechanical related field
    • Minimum of 5 to 8 years experience in gasoline and diesel engine repair and maintenance
    • Strong knowledge of diesel and gasoline engines, vehicle systems, mechanical equipment and basic electrical repairs
    • Experience diagnosing, repairing and maintaining light and heavy duty trucks and equipment
    • Ability to plan, organize, supervise and delegate work effectively
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem solving skills
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Spanish
    • Valid driver's license with the ability to operate heavy duty trucks, tow heads and machinery
